content: Step 2 upgrades the cap. With the fluorine gone the molecule is CC(=O)N..., and that canonical prefix has put the acetyl methyl at index 0 and its carbonyl at index 1 in every molecule of this series I have inspected, so atom 1 is the carbonyl and atom 0 the methyl, a non-ring bond. Replacing that methyl with a cyclopropyl gives N-[4-[(4-methylpyridin-2-yl)amino]phenyl]cyclopropanecarboxamide at about 281 Da: conjugated anilide N-H, a free arylamine N-H with the pyridine nitrogen ortho to it, monocyclic azine, 4-methyl on the ring, no deactivating fluorine, two aromatic rings, two donors, TPSA near 54 and SA under 1.8. Every feature that measured positive, nothing that measured negative.
